items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I got Mike Lala, good trumpet man here, good lead trumpet man, and Harry Shields on clarinet... And I used Harry Shields, but I bought Raymond Boykin. They also played two clarinets on two of the tunes.

ctx.x: Well, that was in late 53. I really started out in 54. I thought there was a lot of boys, for instance, like Raymond Boyk, Harry Shields, Ormond Hug, that didn't want to leave New Orleans for different reasons. I thought they should be heard. So I started this little recording company to give the outside people a chance to hear people like Raymond and them. And I think the little label clicked. Up to day, I have probably 17 albums. And so far, the reviewers have been very nice to us. We got some excellent…
Even Al Hurt never recorded before you did, did he?
